releaseNotes.headline: Memory and storage, in glass
releaseNotes.summary: Explore memory and disk usage as interactive liquid paperweights, with matching miniatures in the rail and clearer access to active work.

highlights.title: Memory and storage paperweights
highlights.detail: The Branches window opens on two glass paperweights. Their liquid layers show each AI tool’s memory share and the disk space used by the system, apps, tools, build cache, and worktrees.

highlights.title: Turn, zoom, and explore
highlights.detail: Bring either paperweight to the front, drag to turn the camera, scroll or pinch to zoom, and select a layer to see what it contains. Choose the ships floating above the liquid.

highlights.title: A matching view in the rail
highlights.detail: Miniature Memory and Storage paperweights show your chosen ships and free space. Hover Storage for the latest measured breakdown and open the Branches window directly to Storage.

highlights.title: Work stays visible
highlights.detail: Recently active sessions remain listed even without a measured process in their folder. On-demand scene rendering and a bounded label cache reduce unnecessary graphics work.
